language.title: Language
language.text: Applies to your account. The others choose their own. The operator adds more languages under Settings, Languages.

phone.title: On the phone
phone.text: For on the go: nexpaper opens with the big buttons Take a photo and Choose a file, and below them what is happening.
phone.quickStart: Start with the quick upload on the phone
phone.quickStartHint: "All" leads from there into the whole app.

auth.name: Name
auth.nameHint: You sign in with it: 2 to 64 letters without accents, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.

setup.title: Set up nexpaper
setup.text: The first account runs this server: it invites people and may change every setting. It does not look into the personal vaults of the others.
setup.codeHint: It stands in the server log (docker logs nexpaper), or set NEXPAPER_SETUP_TOKEN.

login.title: Sign in
login.passwordOff: Sign-in with a password is turned off here. Only the operator can still use it.

code.title: Second factor
code.text: The code from your app, or a recovery code.
code.label: Code from the app
code.hint: Six digits. Or one of your recovery codes.
code.textPasskey: Sign in with your passkey, or give a recovery code.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.text: You are invited to nexpaper. Make yourself an account. Your personal vault stays closed to everybody else.
invite.invalidText: This invitation no longer works: it was used, has run out or was withdrawn. Ask for a new one.
invite.noWay: Sign-in with a password is off and no sign-in provider is set up. Ask the operator.
invite.haveAccount: This link is for a new account. You are signed in as {{name}} already and do not need it.

remember.label: Stay signed in on this device
remember.hint: Good for your own phone, not for other people's devices.
remember.ends_one: Until you have not been here for {{count}} day.
remember.ends_other: Until you have not been here for {{count}} days.

setup2fa.title: Set up your second factor
setup2fa.text: The operator requires a second factor for every account that signs in with a password. Set it up to go on.
setup2fa.scan: Scan the code with an authenticator app, or type in the key. Then the code the app shows.
setup2fa.passkeyLater: Rather without an app? You can add a passkey afterwards under My account → Security.

codes.title: Your recovery codes
codes.text: Each one signs you in once, when the phone is not at hand. They are shown only now: keep them apart from the phone.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.text: Enter your name or your mail address. If there is an account with a mail address for it, we send a link with which you choose a new password.
forgot.label: Name or mail address
forgot.sent: If there is such an account, a link is on its way. It works once and for 24 hours.

reset.title: New password
reset.text: Choose a new password for {{name}}. Every device signs in again afterwards. Your second factor stays.
reset.invalidText: This link does not work any more: it was used or has run out. Ask for a new one, or tap "Forgot your password?" when signing in.
reset.doneText: You can sign in with the new password now.

mail.title: Confirm the mail address
mail.text: {{address}} was given for the account {{name}}. Confirm it with one click.
mail.oldTold: We told the old address about the change.
mail.invalidText: This link does not work any more: it was used, has run out or was withdrawn. Send yourself a new one under My account.

about.subtitle: Documents for households and small firms: upload, find, done.
about.fontsText: nexpaper brings its fonts along, so that opening it asks no other server.

updates.title: Updates
updates.text: Whether a newer version of nexpaper is out.
updates.dailyHint: Asks GitHub for the newest release when somebody opens this page, once a day at most. Off: only when you press the button.
updates.whatGoesOut: Only the question goes out: a request to api.github.com for the newest release of nexpaper, with no names, documents or settings. Besides the mail server, the AI and the mailbox, if you set them up, the push services of the browsers, the import from Paperless when somebody starts it, and the sign-in providers when somebody signs in through them, it is the only call nexpaper makes on its own.

me.title: My account

profile.text: How the others see you on your documents, notes and in the history.
profile.displayHintPassword: Empty shows your user name {{name}}; you still sign in with it.
profile.name: Name
profile.hint: A photo from your phone or camera. It is cut to a square, and nothing of the file but the picture is kept: no place, no device.

password.title: Password
password.done: Password changed. Every other device is signed out.

me.setupFirst: The operator requires a second factor. Set it up here, then you can go on.

ai.notAllowed: Your operator has not allowed the AI for your account.
ai.title: AI when filing
ai.text: Proposes title, sender, kind, date and amount in the inbox. You always confirm yourself.
ai.mineHint: Off: your uploads get only rules and what nexpaper reads itself, and your text never goes to a model.

push.title: Notifications on your devices
push.text: Notices come as a push straight to the phone or into the browser, even while nexpaper is closed. You sign up each device on its own.
push.name: Name of the device
push.ready: Not signed up yet. The browser will ask whether nexpaper may send notifications.
push.denied: The browser blocked notifications for nexpaper. Allow them in the settings of the site (the lock left of the address), then carry on here.
push.insecure: This address has no https, so push does not work. Open nexpaper at its https address.
push.iphone: On the iPhone it only works from the app on the home screen. Put nexpaper there and open it from there.
push.hintHttps: Push needs an address with https (or localhost).
push.hintIphone: On the iPhone it only works from the app on the home screen: Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. From iOS 16.4.
push.deniedNow: Notifications are not allowed. Without them nexpaper cannot send anything.
push.probeHint: Arrives on every device signed up.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.ends_one: A sign-in ends by itself after {{count}} day without use.
devices.ends_other: A sign-in ends by itself after {{count}} days without use.
devices.notify: Tell me about a new sign-in
devices.notifyHint: By push to your devices and by mail: which device, which browser, roughly from where. If it was not you, one tap signs it off.
devices.endedAll: Every other device is signed out.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.text: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or the device's PIN, without password and without code. A passkey counts as two factors by itself and cannot be phished.
passkeys.how: The browser will ask for your fingerprint, face or PIN. The passkey stays on the device or in your keychain.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.removeText: Nobody gets in with this passkey afterwards. Delete it on the device too when you no longer need it.
passkeys.unavailable: Passkeys work only over https (or localhost) and in browsers that know them.
passkeys.noAddressOperator: Enter the public address first (<settings>Settings → Sign-in</settings>).
passkeys.noAddressMember: Your operator has to enter the public address first.

oidc.addressOffer: {{provider}} knows you as {{address}}. Should nexpaper take this address?
oidc.addressTaken: The address is your account's now. Confirm it under Profile, then it counts for documents by mail too.

me.keysWait: Devices and API keys work only once you set up a second factor.

twofactor.title: Second factor
twofactor.lead: Besides the password, a code from an app on your phone. Recovery codes on paper get you in when the phone is gone.
twofactor.scan: Scan this code with the app, or type the key below into it. Then give the code the app shows, and your password.
twofactor.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
twofactor.passwordHint: Proves it is you at the keyboard.
twofactor.codesLead: Each code signs you in once, when the phone is not at hand. They are shown only now.
twofactor.renewText: The old recovery codes stop working. Give your password to make new ones.
twofactor.disableText: From then on the password alone signs you in. Give it to turn the second factor off.
twofactor.lowCodes: Few recovery codes left. Make new ones while you can still sign in.
twofactor.scanNoPassword: Scan this code with the app, or type the key below into it. Then give the code the app shows.
twofactor.required: It cannot be turned off: the operator requires it for everybody.

invite.noMail: Without a mail server nexpaper sends nothing: copy the link and pass it on yourself.
invite.once: The link works once. It is shown only now.

server.permissionsHint: Single accounts can be left out of the AI.
server.accountsHint: Who uses nexpaper. Every account gets its personal vault when it is made. As the operator you manage accounts and shared vaults; you do not look into personal vaults.
server.inviteText: Whoever follows the link makes an account of their own. Without a mail server you copy the link and pass it on yourself.
server.givePassword: Send a link for a password

promote.text: {{name}} may then change every setting of this server. An operator does not look into the others' personal vaults either.

demote.text: {{name}} becomes a member and no longer reaches the server's settings.

reset.title: Remove the second factor of {{name}}?
reset.text: For a lost phone: the code from the app, the passkeys and the recovery codes go, every device is signed out, and the person is told. At the next sign-in they set the second factor up again.

signout.title: Sign {{name}} out everywhere?
signout.text: Every device of the account has to sign in again.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.text: {{name}} no longer gets in, open sessions end at once. Unblocking works at any time.

unblock.title: Unblock {{name}}?
unblock.text: {{name}} can sign in again afterwards, with their own password or through the sign-in provider.

backup_restore.title: Restore this backup?
backup_restore.text: The current state is backed up first. nexpaper restarts, everybody signs in again.

backup_download.title: Download this backup?
backup_download.text: It holds every account, the filing and the server's secrets, but no documents. It is not encrypted.

backup_upload.title: Upload a backup?
backup_upload.text: The file joins the list of backups. Nothing is restored until you confirm it there.

two_factor_off.title: Stop requiring a second factor?
two_factor_off.text: Then a password alone is enough again to read documents. Whoever has a second factor already keeps it.

link.title: Send {{name}} a link to reset the password?
link.text: The person chooses their password themselves. The link goes by mail to their address when mail is set up, otherwise you get it once to pass on. The second factor stays.

unlink.title: Unlink {{name}}?
unlink.text: {{name}} no longer signs in through {{provider}} afterwards and is told. The account can link itself again when needed.

server.twoFactorRequiredHint: Every account that signs in with a password must set it up before it gets any further. Accounts from the provider bring their own. An account with a password is not affected either when it comes in through a provider for which “{{trusts}}” is on.
server.ownSecondFactorFirst: Set up your own second factor first (My account, Security), or you would be the first one who cannot go on. Not affected is whoever signs in through a provider for which “{{trusts}}” is on.
server.secretKept: stored, leave empty to keep it
server.mailHint: For sending: invitations, "Forgot your password?", confirming mail addresses, the notice of a new sign-in. Without a server the link to copy is enough, and "Forgot your password?" is missing at sign-in.
server.backupsHint: One file with the database, the settings and the server's secrets: accounts, vaults, filing, recognised text, notes, history. With the server's secret it also holds the mail and AI credentials and the addresses of open links, so keep it protected, like a password. Restoring shows a trial run first.
server.uploadedHint: Uploaded. It is in the list now: check it first, then restore.
server.checkOk: Readable: {{accounts}}. Restoring replaces the current state; it is backed up first.
server.checkBad: Damaged: this backup cannot be restored.
server.restarting: nexpaper restarts with the backup. The page reloads in a moment.
server.languagesHint: German and English are built in. Add more as a JSON file; missing texts fall back to English.
server.languageAdded: Language added. It appears under My account, Profile.
server.logHint: What the server did. Without the content of documents.
server.logClearText: Every line goes. New ones come as before.
server.checkNewer: This backup comes from a newer version of nexpaper. Update nexpaper first, then restore.

ai.title: AI proposals in the inbox
ai.text: Applies to everybody. The AI proposes title, sender, kind, date and amount; only what a person confirms is filed. Rules always come first.
ai.noneNote: Only rules and what nexpaper reads from the text itself (date, amount, sender as last time).
ai.localNote: Ollama or another service in the own network. The recognised text stays in your network.
ai.messagesNote: Your own API key. The recognised text goes to the provider, never the image.
ai.openaiNote: Your own API key and address. The recognised text goes to the service, never the image.
ai.keyKept: saved, leave empty to keep it
ai.probed: Saved. Test: the model answered in {{seconds}} seconds.
ai.outgoing: What goes out: the recognised text of the first two pages of a new document, without the image, without the name of the account, plus the list of kinds. Nothing else. Whoever does not want that switches the AI off in their account.
ai.keyLocalHint: Only when the service asks for one, such as LiteLLM. Ollama needs none.

push.title: Web Push
push.text: So that notices reach the phone and the browser: of a new sign-in, of an export that is ready or failed or a finished import from Paperless, of a second factor that was reset or an account that was unlinked from a sign-in provider. Operators also hear when the check of the files finds something wrong or a restore fails. Set up from the start; each person signs up their devices under My account.
push.contactHint: The services of Google, Apple and Mozilla ask for an address where they reach the operator. It stands in every message, nothing else of yours.
push.keysText: nexpaper made a key pair of its own. Making a new one signs every device off; each person has to sign them up again.
push.renewText: Every device is signed off. Each person has to sign them up again under My account, Devices and apps.
push.renewed: New key pair made. Every device is signed off.
push.hostsHint: Messages go only to the services of Google, Mozilla, Apple and Microsoft. If a browser needs another one, enter its host here, one per line, such as push.example.com.
push.out: What goes out: an encrypted message to the push service of each browser. Only the device can read it. It never holds the content of a document.

server.linkSent: The link for {{name}} went to {{email}}. It works once and for 24 hours.
server.linkShown: The link for {{name}}, shown only now, valid once and for 24 hours. Pass it on, the person chooses the password themselves:
server.checkMissing_one: {{count}} document is missing on the disk.
server.checkMissing_other: {{count}} documents are missing on the disk.
server.backupNoDocuments: The documents themselves are not in the backup.
server.backupNoDocumentsText: They lie as plain files under /data/dokumente, readable without nexpaper too. Put this folder into the backup your server makes anyway (Hyper Backup, restic, snapshots). Whoever backs up only this file has filing without documents after a disk failure.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.text: Programs read or upload with a key that each person makes under My account. Here you allow that and see every key, never the key itself.
apiKeys.allowHint: Off: nobody can make keys, and existing ones stop working.
apiKeys.blockText: It stops working at once, for good. The account sees it blocked in its list.
apiKeys.offHint: A key only reads or only uploads, and never does more than its account may.

interface.title: Interface
interface.text: Everything the web app can do works through /api/v1 as well. Helpers and programs of your own build on it.
interface.schemaText: OpenAPI, for tools and code generators
interface.pairText: QR code from My account, a key of its own for each device
interface.authText: device or key in the header of every request; they need no password and no session
interface.limits: Limits per key: 120 requests a minute, 50 uploads an hour. Wrong keys count like wrong passwords.

remove.title: Delete {{name}}?
remove.text: The account is deleted with everything that belongs to it and cannot be brought back. Links {{name}} created stop working at once.
remove.none: There are no documents in the own vault.
remove.documents_one: The own vault holds {{n}} document, the trash included. Where should it go?
remove.documents_other: The own vault holds {{n}} documents, the trash included. Where should they go?
remove.toPersonHint: Into their own vault; the documents then belong to them. The person and everybody with rights in their vault will see them.
remove.toVaultHint: Every member of that vault will see them.
remove.noVault: There is no shared vault yet.
remove.deleteAll: Delete them too, with their files
remove.deleteAllHint: For good, also for everybody they were shared with.
remove.soleManager: {{name}} alone manages {{vaults}}. First give somebody else the right to manage there.
remove.typeName: To confirm, type the account name {{name}}
remove.youSee: You will see the documents yourself afterwards.

restorePreview.title: Trial run
restorePreview.allThere: All their files lie on the disk.
restorePreview.missing_one: {{count}} document has a file missing on the disk.
restorePreview.missing_other: {{count}} documents have a file missing on the disk.
restorePreview.changed_one: {{count}} document has a file with another checksum.
restorePreview.changed_other: {{count}} documents have a file with another checksum.
restorePreview.notCompared_one: {{count}} file was only looked for, there was no time to read it.
restorePreview.notCompared_other: {{count}} files were only looked for, there was no time to read them.
restorePreview.newer_one: Restoring removes {{count}} document that came in since. Its files stay in the folder.
restorePreview.newer_other: Restoring removes {{count}} documents that came in since. Their files stay in the folder.
restorePreview.index: The search is built anew afterwards. That takes a while, and until then it finds more and more.
restorePreview.revivedDevices_one: Restoring makes {{count}} device valid again that was locked out or removed since the backup.
restorePreview.revivedDevices_other: Restoring makes {{count}} devices valid again that were locked out or removed since the backup.
restorePreview.revivedKeys_one: Restoring makes {{count}} key valid again that was blocked since the backup.
restorePreview.revivedKeys_other: Restoring makes {{count}} keys valid again that were blocked since the backup.
restorePreview.revivedLinks_one: Restoring makes {{count}} link valid again that was withdrawn since the backup.
restorePreview.revivedLinks_other: Restoring makes {{count}} links valid again that were withdrawn since the backup.

server.sizeNote: The backup is made while nexpaper runs, through SQLite's own backup function, nothing stalls. The search index is not in it and is built anew after a restore. Download, delete and restore ask for your password.

errors.ai_not_allowed: Your operator has not allowed the AI for your account.
errors.account_locked: Too many wrong tries. The account waits a quarter of an hour.
errors.api_off: The operator has not switched API keys on.
errors.avatar_not_a_picture: This is not a picture nexpaper takes (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC or AVIF).
errors.avatar_too_large: The picture is too large, at most {{max_mb}} MB.
errors.backup_damaged: The backup is damaged. Nothing was changed.
errors.backup_invalid: This is not a nexpaper backup.
errors.backup_too_large: The backup unpacks to more than a backup may hold. Nothing was changed.
errors.backup_too_new: The backup comes from a newer version of nexpaper. Nothing was changed.
errors.bad_preference: nexpaper does not offer this value.
errors.busy: nexpaper is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot take the operator role from yourself.
errors.client_required: The request did not say which tab it came from. Reload the page.
errors.display_name_invalid: A display name cannot hold control or invisible characters.
errors.display_name_taken: Another account goes by this name.
errors.display_name_too_long: The display name is too long, at most 80 characters.
errors.duration_not_allowed: This duration is not possible here.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.invalid_account_name: A sign-in name has 2 to 64 characters: letters without accents, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore, no spaces.
errors.invalid_days: Choose one of the offered lifetimes.
errors.invalid_email: This is not a mail address.
errors.invite_invalid: This invitation is no longer valid.
errors.issuer_invalid: This is not an OpenID Connect provider.
errors.issuer_unreachable: The provider cannot be reached at this address.
errors.locale_unusable: This language file cannot be used.
errors.log_level_from_environment: The level is fixed in the environment (NEXPAPER_LOG_LEVEL).
errors.mail_failed: The mail server did not take the mail.
errors.mail_off: No mail server is set up.
errors.not_found: Not found, or not open to you.
errors.oidc_account: This account signs in through the provider.
errors.operator_network: The operator's settings can be reached from the home network only.
errors.operator_only: Only the operator may do this.
errors.origin_refused: The API is for programs, not web pages.
errors.own_second_factor_first: Set up your own second factor first, on your account page.
errors.password_login_off: Sign-in with a password is turned off.
errors.password_mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
errors.password_too_short: The password is too short, at least 12 characters.
errors.provider_first: Set up a sign-in provider first, or nobody but you gets in any more.
errors.public_url_missing: For mail, nexpaper needs its public address; the operator sets it under Settings.
errors.second_factor_expired: Too many wrong codes, or waited too long. Start over with the password.
errors.second_factor_setup_required: Set up your second factor first.
errors.second_factor_unavailable: The second factor cannot be checked on this installation. Ask the operator to reset it.
errors.setup_code_wrong: The setup code is wrong. It stands in the server's log.
errors.slow_down: Too many requests with this key. Wait a minute.
errors.token_wrong_kind: This is the wrong kind of key for this route: device tokens and API keys are two different things.
errors.too_large: The file is larger than allowed, at most {{max_mb}} MB.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.totp_code_wrong: The code is not right. A code from the app: check the time on the phone. A recovery code works once only.
errors.totp_enabled: The second factor is on already.
errors.totp_enrolment_expired: Setting up took too long. Start again.
errors.totp_not_enabled: The second factor is not on.
errors.unknown_language: nexpaper does not have this language.
errors.url_invalid: The address must start with http:// or https://.
errors.use_disable: Turn your own second factor off on your account page.
errors.ai_off: No AI is set up on this server.
errors.ai_switched_off: You switched the AI off for yourself (My account, AI).
errors.ai_incomplete: The AI is not set up completely yet. The operator has to enter the address and the model.
errors.ai_provider_unknown: There is no such kind of AI service.
errors.ai_address_missing: Give the address of the service.
errors.ai_address_invalid: This is not the address of a service, such as http://ollama:11434/v1.
errors.ai_https_required: A service on the internet is reached over https only.
errors.ai_address_private: This address lies in the own network. Choose "Local model" for it.
errors.ai_address_public: This address lies on the internet. A local model has to stay in the own network, or "Nothing leaves the house" would not be true.
errors.ai_unreachable: The server cannot reach the AI service.
errors.ai_timeout: The AI service took too long (more than {{seconds}} seconds).
errors.ai_key_refused: The AI service refused the key.
errors.ai_address_not_found: The AI service does not know this address or this model.
errors.ai_service_busy: The AI service is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.ai_service_failed: The AI service answered with an error ({{answered}}). {{said}}
errors.ai_unreadable: The answer of the AI service could not be read.
errors.ai_no_list: This service names no models. Type the name of the model yourself.
errors.ai_too_often: Too many requests to the AI. Wait a moment.
errors.ai_busy: The AI is already working on a request of yours.
errors.ai_server_busy: The AI is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.push_endpoint_invalid: This is not the address of a push service.
errors.push_service_unknown: nexpaper sends nothing to this push service. The operator can add it under Settings → Web Push.
errors.push_unreachable: The server cannot reach the push service.
errors.push_keys_invalid: The keys of this device are not valid.
errors.push_too_many_devices: At most {{max}} devices. Sign one off first.
errors.push_name_invalid: Use a shorter name without control characters.
errors.push_no_devices: Turn it on for this device first.
errors.push_contact_invalid: Give an address starting with mailto: or https://.
errors.push_host_invalid: This is not a host name: {{entry}}
errors.push_too_often: Too much at once. Wait a minute.
errors.second_factor_required: The operator requires a second factor. You cannot turn off the last one.
errors.sign_in_again: Sign in again through the provider, then try once more right away.
errors.this_session: Here you sign out with “Sign out”.
errors.not_in_setup: There is nothing to confirm any more. Reload the page.
errors.passkey_expired: That took too long. Start again.
errors.passkey_invalid: The browser's answer does not fit. Try again.
errors.passkeys_need_https: Passkeys work only when nexpaper is reached over https (or on localhost).
errors.too_many_passkeys: No more than ten passkeys per account.
errors.passkey_cancelled: Cancelled. The browser did not hand over a passkey.
errors.passkey_unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys here.
errors.reset_invalid: This link does not work any more.
errors.reset_off: This is not set up on this server. Ask the operator.
errors.use_account_page: You change your own password under My account.
errors.browser_only: This needs a signed-in browser, not a device.
errors.device_name_invalid: The name of a device has 1 to 80 characters, without control characters.
errors.too_many_devices: That is enough devices: block one first.
errors.too_many_keys: That is enough keys: delete one first.
errors.email_same: This is your confirmed address already.
errors.email_link_invalid: This link does not work any more.
errors.forbidden: Your right does not allow this.
errors.invalid_name: The name may have 1 to 80 characters, without control characters.
errors.personal_vault: A personal vault belongs to its person and stays as it is.
errors.vault_not_empty: The vault still holds documents. Choose where they go.
errors.owner_stays_manager: Whoever owns a personal vault always manages it.
errors.last_manager: A vault needs at least one person who manages it.
errors.personal_vault_not_empty: The own vault still holds {{documents}} documents. Choose where they go.
errors.invalid_recipient: Say whom the link is for (up to 100 characters).
errors.links_off: The operator has switched links to the outside off.
errors.too_many_links: Too many links are open on this document already.
errors.already_in_vault: This person is in the vault already.
errors.in_trash: The document is in the trash. Restore it first.
errors.download_not_allowed: This link does not allow downloading.
errors.in_use_elsewhere: Documents you may not change still use it.
errors.invalid_amount: Write an amount like amount:>100 or amount:<12.50.
errors.invalid_date: This date is out of range.
errors.invalid_date_kind: There is no such kind of date.
errors.invalid_note: A note has 1 to 5,000 characters, without control characters.
errors.invalid_status: A document can go to the inbox or to the archive.
errors.invalid_title: A title has 1 to 200 characters, without control characters.
errors.kind_unknown: This kind does not exist any more.
errors.still_processing: The document is still being read. It will be ready in a moment.
errors.too_many_tags: At most 30 tags on a document.
errors.invalid_sender: A sender has 1 to 160 characters, without control characters.
errors.invalid_tag: A tag has 1 to 40 characters, without control characters.
errors.link_unreadable: This address cannot be shown any more. Create a new link.
errors.name_mismatch: The name does not match. Type it exactly as shown.
errors.sync_from_start: This state is too old. Sync again from the start.
errors.too_many_members: A vault cannot hold that many members.
errors.unsupported_type: nexpaper does not take this kind of file. PDF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, HEIC, WebP, AVIF and e-invoices as XML are allowed.
errors.xml_not_invoice: nexpaper takes XML only as an e-invoice (UBL or CII).
errors.xml_doctype: This XML file holds a document type definition. nexpaper does not take those, for safety.
errors.too_many_files: Too many files in one request. The rest has to follow on its own.

ready.title: Ready for the internet?
ready.text: Many reach nexpaper from on the road too. nexpaper checks this itself, every time you open the page.

https.title: Public address with https
https.warn: {{address}} has https, but this request came without. Open nexpaper under that address, or let the proxy send X-Forwarded-Proto and name it in NEXPAPER_TRUSTED_PROXIES.
https.bad: Without https, passwords travel the network in the clear, and Web Push and passkeys do not work at all. Enter the public address with https below.

two_factor.title: Second factor for everybody
two_factor.ok: Whoever signs in with a password needs a code or a passkey as well.
two_factor.bad: Off: a guessed or stolen password is enough to read all documents of that person. Turn on "Require a second factor" below.

own_account.title: Your own account
own_account.bad: Has no second factor yet, and it may change everything. Set it up under My account, Security.

brake.title: Protection against guessing
brake.ok: After 5 wrong tries a 15 minute pause, per account and per address. Every try is in the log.
brake.warn: All visitors come through a proxy nexpaper does not know: the pause holds per account, per address only roughly. See “Behind the proxy”.
brake.bad: The list of trusted proxies holds public networks ({{networks}}). Anybody could then make up the sender's address, and the pause after wrong tries no longer holds. List only the address of your proxy.
brake.broken: The protection against guessing fails its own test. Restart nexpaper; if that does not help, please report it.

cookies.title: Sessions and cookies
cookies.ok_one: Cookies only over https and not readable by scripts; a sign-in runs out after {{count}} day without use.
cookies.ok_other: Cookies only over https and not readable by scripts; a sign-in runs out after {{count}} days without use.
cookies.warn: Without https the sign-in cookies travel in the clear. Over https nexpaper protects them by itself.
cookies.bad: NEXPAPER_COOKIE_SECURE is off: the cookies go unprotected even over https. Set it to auto.

proxy.title: Behind the proxy
proxy.ok: The visitors' real address arrives (proxy {{proxies}} entered as trusted). Without that the protection against guessing would see everybody as one.
proxy.direct: The visitors arrive directly, without a proxy in between.
proxy.warn: The requests come through a proxy ({{proxy}}) that is not entered as trusted: the protection against guessing sees everybody as one. Set NEXPAPER_TRUSTED_PROXIES to its address.
proxy.bad: Public networks are listed as trusted ({{networks}}). Set NEXPAPER_TRUSTED_PROXIES to the address of your proxy, not to the whole internet.

secrets.title: Server secrets
secrets.ok: The key for the OIDC secret, the mail password and the AI key can be read by the owner only.
secrets.env: The key comes from NEXPAPER_SECRET_KEY, not from a file.
secrets.bad: The file {{path}} can be read by others too (mode {{mode}}). Set it to 600, the owner only.

backups.title: Backup
backups.ok: An automatic backup is on. The documents themselves belong in your server's own backup.
backups.warn: No automatic backup. Turn it on under Settings, Backup.

home.title: Inbox
home.emptyText: New things arrive from the phone, the mailbox, the inbox folder or through "Upload".

mail.title: Mail address
mail.text: For "Forgot your password?" and notices such as a new sign-in. A new address counts only after you open the link in the mail sent to it.
mail.sent: Link sent. Until you open it, the old address stays.
mail.off: The operator has not set up a mail server yet, so no link can be sent.
mail.passwordHint: For safety: the address is the way back into the account.
mail.passwordFirst: Enter the password above for that

looks.title: Light or dark
looks.archiveText: How the list looks when you open nexpaper.

pairing.title: Pair a device
pairing.text: For programs and apps of your own. The device gets a key of its own that you can block any time.
pairing.name: Name of the device
pairing.useIt: The device sends it with every request as Authorization: Bearer.
pairing.takeOffText: The key of the device stops working at once. It has to be paired again.
pairing.hint: A device acts with the rights of your account. It cannot change settings or pair other devices.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.text: For your own scripts, nexdeck or a scanner that uploads directly. A key can only read or only upload, never change settings.
apiKeys.off: The operator has not allowed API keys.
apiKeys.offForOperator: API keys are not allowed yet.
apiKeys.enableText: After that every person on this server can make keys under My account. A key lets a program either only read or only upload, never more than the account that made it may. You can switch this off again under Settings, API at any time; keys that exist stop working then too.
apiKeys.uploadNote: A key for uploading only puts documents into an inbox: the one of your target vault or, when the program names another, the one of a vault you may add to. It cannot read, change or delete anything.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.lifetimeHint: A key that never runs out is the one nobody remembers when it falls into the wrong hands. A year is usually enough; the list shows a week ahead that it runs out.
apiKeys.lifetimeHintUpload: A key for uploading can only put documents into your inbox. It does not read your archive. So it does not run out by itself, and a shortcut or a scanner does not have to be set up again after a year. You can delete it at any time, or choose a time.
apiKeys.docs: Everything the web app can do works through the interface under /api/v1 as well. The description is at /api/v1/docs.

edit.name: Edit
edit.text: Also upload, file, change fields, edit pages.

vaults.title: Vaults
vaults.intro: Everybody has a vault of their own that, at first, only they can see. Shared vaults such as “Household” are created by the operator. Who may do what is shown on every vault.
vaults.sharedWithMe: Shared with you one by one
vaults.note: Note: a personal vault means that nexpaper shows it to nobody else. The files are stored as plain files on the server, so that they stay yours without nexpaper; whoever runs the server can see them there.
vaults.createText: For everything that belongs to several people: household, car, holiday flat, a small business. You decide afterwards who may do what.
vaults.loadFailed: The vaults could not be loaded.

share.title: Share
share.peopleText: In the vault {{vault}}, {{names}} can see it already. Here you give this one document to other single people.
share.everyone: Everybody here can see it already.
share.linksOff: The operator has switched links to the outside off.
share.linkText: For people without an account, such as a tax advisor, an insurer or a landlord. The link shows this document only and expires on its own.
share.maxDays: At most {{days}} days, as set by the operator.
share.noPeople: Nobody else has an account on this server.
share.madeShown: Link created. Here it is to copy.
share.ended: its maker can no longer share

link.sharedBy: <name>{{name}}</name> has shared a document with you
link.sharedByUnknown: A document was shared with you
link.processing: The document is still being processed. Look in again in a few minutes.
link.footer: Only this document is shared. {{name}} sees when the link was opened and can revoke it at any time.
link.footerUnknown: Only this document is shared. Whoever made the link sees when it was opened and can revoke it at any time.
link.goneText: It has run out or was revoked, or the address is not quite right. Ask the person who sent it.
link.viewOnly: Shared for viewing only, without downloading.
link.noPages: The pages cannot be shown here. If you need the document, ask the person who sent you the link.

sharingSettings.title: Links to the outside
sharingSettings.text: Lets you give single documents or an export to people without an account, such as your tax advisor.
sharingSettings.allowHint: Off: sharing only with people on this server. Existing links stop working at once.
sharingSettings.hint: A link shows only the one document or the one export, cannot be guessed and can be revoked at any time. Opening it is noted in the history of the document, at most once every ten minutes per link.
sharingSettings.none: No link is open right now.
sharingSettings.overview: {{links}} from {{people}}, the next one expires on {{date}}.

history.taken_over: Taken over when the account {{account}} was deleted

upload.dropText: PDF, pictures, e-invoices as XML. Everything lands in the inbox first.

status.done: Uploaded. It is being read and then waits in the inbox.
status.doneSame: Uploaded, but you have the same file already as “{{title}}”.
status.doneSimilar: Uploaded. It looks like the document “{{title}}”.
status.exists: You have this file already as “{{title}}”. Nothing was transferred.
status.paused: Interrupted, {{percent}} % have arrived. “Resume” goes on from there.
status.doneIn: Uploaded to “{{vault}}”. It is being read and then waits in the inbox.

toast.one: Uploaded. It is being read and then waits in the inbox.
toast.many_one: {{count}} file uploaded. It is being read.
toast.many_other: {{count}} files uploaded. They are being read.
toast.exists_one: {{count}} file was there already and was not transferred.
toast.exists_other: {{count}} files were there already and were not transferred.
toast.oneIn: Uploaded to “{{vault}}”. It is being read and then waits in the inbox.
toast.manyIn_one: {{count}} file uploaded to “{{vault}}”. It is being read.
toast.manyIn_other: {{count}} files uploaded to “{{vault}}”. They are being read.

limits.title: Uploading and limits
limits.text: What nexpaper takes and how much. Applies to the browser, the phone and apps, from the next file on.
limits.maxFileHint: Larger files are refused. Files over 8 MB go in pieces, and after a break in the network they go on where they stopped.
limits.maxPagesHint: A PDF with more pages stays in the inbox with a note.
limits.maxMegapixelsHint: Protects against small files that would be huge once opened.
limits.openCountHint: Uploads in pieces that are not finished. They run out after 24 hours without a piece.
limits.openMbHint: The size of all open uploads together.
limits.timeoutHint: If reading takes longer it is stopped and tried twice more. The accounts take turns.
limits.memoryHint: 0 means no limit, otherwise at least 256. Works only where the system allows it.
limits.invalid: The numbers must lie in the allowed range.
limits.cacheHint: When it grows past this, nexpaper clears the pictures that were not used for the longest time. They are made again when needed.

disk.title: How the files lie on the disk
disk.text: Readable even without nexpaper. If you ever stop using nexpaper, you keep your folders.
disk.note: Originals are never changed, and every file carries a checksum. From a photo nexpaper makes a PDF beside it. Deleted documents stay 30 days in the trash, then they are gone with their files.
disk.english: Where the date, the sender or the kind is missing, the folders and files on the disk have English names: “undated”, “no sender”, “Document”. The app shows them translated.

quick.photoText: Letter, invoice, receipt. Several pages work.
quick.fileText: PDF from Files, mail or a download
quick.rulesHint: Rules may move it afterwards, say everything from the utility company to Household.
quick.inInbox: in the inbox, waiting to be filed
quick.none: Nothing from you yet. Take a photo of a sheet or choose a file.
quick.done: Uploaded. It will be in the inbox in a moment.
quick.doneMany: {{count}} files uploaded. They will be in the inbox in a moment.

share.missed: What you shared did not arrive because nexpaper was not fully set up on this phone yet. Choose the file here once more.
share.one: The shared file is being uploaded.
share.title: Shared from another app
share.gone: Nothing is left here to upload.

camera.hintLive: Take the pages one after another. “Done” makes one document of them.
camera.hintAdjust: Drag the dots to the corners of the sheet if they are not quite right.
camera.noCameraText: There is no camera here, or nexpaper may not use it. Allow it in the browser’s settings, or choose a photo or PDF as a file.
camera.insecure: The camera works only when nexpaper is reached over https. Choose a photo or PDF as a file.
camera.noEdges: The edge finder does not load. Take the picture yourself and drag the corners by hand.
camera.failed: The page could not be processed. Try once more.

pair.scan: Scan it with the device. The code is valid for 5 minutes and once.
pair.paired: Paired. The device now stands under Security with the signed-in devices.
pair.provider: Whoever signs in through {{name}} can sign a device in there too. The second factor counts either way.

iphone.title: From other apps on the iPhone
iphone.text: On the iPhone nexpaper is missing from the share menu, because Safari does not allow it for web apps. A shortcut steps in: it then stands in the share menu of every app and sends PDFs and photos straight to your inbox.
iphone.link1: On the iPhone, tap “Load the shortcut” and add it.
iphone.link2: While it is added it asks for the address and a key: “Key for the shortcut” below shows both.
iphone.link3: In Mail, Files or the banking app: Share, then “Nach nexpaper”.
iphone.build: The operator has not shared a finished shortcut yet. This is how you build it in two minutes:
iphone.build1: Tap “Key for the shortcut” below. The address and a key for uploading then stay there to copy.
iphone.build2: In the Shortcuts app, make a new shortcut “Nach nexpaper”, switch on “Show in Share Sheet” under Details, with PDFs and images as input.
iphone.build3: Action “Get Contents of URL”: the address from below, method POST, header “Authorization” with the value from below, request body Form, field “file” as a file with the Shortcut Input.
iphone.build4: Action “Show Notification” with “It is in the inbox.” after it, done.
iphone.android: On Android nexpaper stands in the share menu by itself once it is on the home screen.
iphone.shown: A key for uploading, for the shortcut, shown only now. It can only upload and then stands with the API keys, where you can delete it.
iphone.warning: Never put your key into a shortcut you share with others: whoever has it can upload into your account. To share a shortcut, set up the address and the key as Import Questions.
iphone.off: The shortcut needs a key for uploading, and the operator has not switched API keys on.

vault.title: Where your uploads go
vault.text: Counts for the phone, the browser, the mailbox and the inbox folder. It can be changed with every upload, and rules may move things. New things wait in the inbox of this vault. In shared vaults every member who may file there sees them.

oauth.title: Pair {{app}} with your account?
oauth.text: The app gets a key of its own for your account and may do everything you may, except change settings and pair more devices. You can block it any time under My account, Security.
oauth.refused: nexpaper does not take this request.

devices.revokeText: Its key stops working at once. It has to be paired again.

keys.uploadButton: Key for uploading (for scanners and apps)
keys.limits: Limits per key: 120 requests a minute, 50 uploads an hour.

settings.title: Shortcut for the iPhone
settings.text: A finished shortcut “Nach nexpaper” for everybody: build it on an iPhone, share it in Shortcuts as an iCloud link and enter the link here. My account then offers “Load the shortcut”. Without a link the page explains how to build it.

folder.title: Intake folder
folder.text: For the scanner in the network or anything that comes in through a share. Every person has their own subfolder; what lands there comes into their inbox.
folder.pathHint: Mounted as a volume in the Compose example. Sharing it over SMB is the server's job, not nexpaper's.
folder.quiet: A file is picked up only once it has not grown for 10 seconds; then it is taken out of the folder.
folder.aside: What is not taken waits in the subfolder “abgelehnt”, with the reason beside it.
folder.personReadonly: read only, nexpaper takes nothing here

mail.title: Mailbox
mail.text: One mailbox for everybody. Whoever forwards invoices there gets the attachments in their inbox; recognised by the sender's address or by {{local}}+name@.
mail.private: Allow a server in the own network
mail.privateHint: Off: only a server on the internet. nexpaper never reaches addresses like 169.254.169.254.
mail.taken: Taken are PDF, pictures and e-invoices as XML. Mails from unknown senders land in the operator's inbox, marked “unknown”; nothing is filed by itself.
mail.fetchedMore: Fetched. Mails: {{mails}}, documents: {{files}}. The rest comes next time.
mail.dropUnknownHint: They stay in the mailbox and do not come into the operator's inbox.
mail.whole: Afterwards happens only once all attachments of a mail are in. Mails with attachments over the limits stay in the mailbox and are flagged.

instead.read: The server cannot delete or move single mails; nexpaper marks them read instead.
instead.move: The server cannot delete single mails; nexpaper moves them to “nexpaper” instead.

mail.authServerHint: Only its verdict counts: when it says dmarc=fail, the mail counts as unknown. Empty: the domain of the mailbox's address. For a hosted mailbox enter the provider's name, such as mx.google.com.

mine.mailText: Forward invoices to {{address}}. nexpaper knows you by your sender address and puts the attachments in your inbox.
mine.addHint: Gets a mail with a confirmation link, so that nobody enters somebody else's address.
mine.sent: Mail with a confirmation link sent to {{address}}.
mine.noMailServer: Without a mail server no address can be confirmed. The operator sets that up.
mine.plus: From any other address it works with your own mailbox address:
mine.folderText: Your subfolder for the scanner in the network. What lands there comes into your inbox and is then taken out of the folder.

confirm.title: Confirm the sender address
confirm.text: Then attachments that {{name}} forwards to nexpaper from {{address}} come into their own inbox.
confirm.doneText: Mails from {{address}} now come into the inbox of {{name}}.
confirm.invalidTitle: This link is not valid any more
confirm.invalidText: It was used already or has run out. A new one can be sent under My account, Upload.

errors.folder_invalid: Give a full path, such as /data/eingang.
errors.folder_forbidden: nexpaper must not take files from this folder.
errors.folder_missing: This folder does not exist in the container.
errors.mail_incomplete: Server, user and password are still missing.
errors.mail_host_invalid: This is not the name of a mail server.
errors.mail_folder_invalid: This is not the name of a folder.
errors.mail_plain_not_local: Without TLS only a mail server on this machine (127.0.0.1) is reached.
errors.mail_address_private: The mail server lies in the own network. Allow servers in the own network first.
errors.mail_unreachable: The mail server cannot be reached.
errors.mail_tls_failed: The secure connection to the mail server failed.
errors.mail_login_failed: The mail server does not know this user or password.
errors.mail_folder_missing: The mailbox has no such folder.
errors.mail_timeout: The mail server took too long.
errors.mail_protocol: The mail server answered in a way nexpaper does not understand.
errors.mail_busy: The mailbox is being fetched right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.sender_is_account: This is the address of your account; it counts already.
errors.sender_link_invalid: This link is not valid any more.
errors.folder_readonly: nexpaper may not move or remove anything in this folder. Until it may, it takes nothing from it.

ocr.title: Text recognition
ocr.text: So that the search finds what is in photos and scans too. PDFs that already have text stay as they are.
ocr.unavailable: This server has no text recognition (ocrmypdf and Tesseract). Only the text a PDF brings along itself is found.
ocr.languagesHint: Each additional language makes the recognition a little slower. nexpaper brings these six along and loads nothing later.
ocr.straighten: Straighten skewed pages and turn them upright
ocr.straightenHint: Pages that are upside down too.
ocr.blank: Treat blank pages as separator sheets
ocr.blankHint: A batch scan is offered for splitting in the inbox.
ocr.pace: On average {{seconds}} seconds per page on this server.
ocr.oneAtATime: Only one document at a time, so that everything else stays smooth.

processError.ocr_timeout: The text recognition took too long. Pages and preview are there, the text is still missing.
processError.ocr_failed: The text could not be recognised. Pages and preview are there, the text is missing.

ocr.longDocument: A long document with {{pages}} pages: recognising its text takes a while. Pages and preview are there already.
ocr.maxMinutesHint: A page may take at most ten times the average. If a document takes longer, it waits in the inbox without text and can be tried again.
ocr.maxMinutesInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1440 minutes.

fields.title: Title
fields.datesHint: Due, contract until, warranty until, keep until.
fields.dateTypo: The year {{typed}} looks like a typo. Did you mean {{year}}?
fields.dateRange: This date does not work. The years {{from}} to {{to}} are allowed.

archive.title: Archive
archive.placeholder: Search titles, senders and the whole text
help: exactly these words in this order
archive.helpParts: Parts of words work too: “werke” finds “Stadtwerke”. Upper and lower case do not matter.
archive.nothingText: Try fewer words, a part of a word, or take a filter out.
archive.emptyText: What you file in the inbox stands here, by month and searchable.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.sub: New things wait here until somebody looks at them and files them. The fields are filled in already.
inbox.readingText: nexpaper reads the pages and the text. Then it fills in the fields; you need not wait.
inbox.looksLike: Looks like a document you have
inbox.sameFile: This very file is in nexpaper already, as “{{title}}”.
inbox.similarFile: Nearly the same text as “{{title}}”. Probably the same letter, scanned or photographed again.
inbox.discarded: Discarded. The one you had stays.

error.encrypted: The PDF is protected by a password
error.too_many_pages: Too many pages for this server
error.too_large: A page or a picture is too large
error.ocr_timeout: Recognising the text took too long
error.ocr_failed: The text could not be recognised

inbox.errorUnreadable: nexpaper could not read the file. You can try again or delete it.
inbox.errorText: Pages and preview are there; only the search does not find the text yet.
inbox.trashed: Put in the trash. It can be restored for 30 days.
inbox.subject: “{{subject}}”
inbox.explain: Every vault has an inbox of its own. Here you see all of those where you may file documents. Each entry says which vault it waits in and who it comes from. In shared vaults everybody who may edit sees the same.
inbox.noMatch: Nothing in the inbox matches this filter.
inbox.sharedGroup: Shared with you one by one ({{count}})
inbox.bulkHint: Filing takes over the proposals. What you choose here applies to everything selected.
inbox.keys: Keys: j next, k back, x select, Ctrl+Enter file.

document.gone: This document does not exist, or no longer.
document.originalCamera: the photos as a PDF, as taken
document.newVersionHint: the old one stays under Versions
document.mergeHint: its pages go at the end
document.noTextToCopy: This document has no text yet.
document.copyFailed: Copying did not work. The text stands under “Text”.
document.moveText: Sender and tags go along. Who sees only the old vault no longer sees the document afterwards.
document.moveNowhere: There is no other vault you may put documents in.
document.savedAsVersion: Saved as a new version. The original stays.
document.linkFor_zero: Link for {{to}}, until {{until}}, not opened yet

text.pending: The text is still being recognised. Then it stands here and the search finds it.
text.none: No text to show: the data of this e-invoice stand under Details.
text.fromFile: The text was in the file already.
text.searchable: The full-text search finds it; the searchable PDF carries it as an invisible layer, so it can be selected.
text.empty: These pages carry no text nexpaper could read.

notes.none: No note yet. Say “paid on 3 April” or “notice sent”. The search finds notes too.
notes.everybody: Everybody who sees the document sees the notes too.

versions.hint: A new version replaces nothing: each one stays with its original until the document is deleted.

events.createdFromArchive: added it: taken from Paperless as the PDF Paperless made of the file ({{what}}). nexpaper does not take that kind of file itself.
events.createdOriginalMissing: added it: taken from Paperless, the original file was missing there, the searchable version was taken instead
events.catalog: changed {{fields}} in the list, for every document with it
events.toInbox: put it back in the inbox
events.linkCreated_one: made a link for one day
events.linkEnded: A link ended because the account that made it was deleted
events.linkCopied: copied the address of a link
events.restored: brought it back from the trash
events.recognised_one: The text of one page was recognised.
events.recognised_other: The text of {{count}} pages was recognised.
events.processedNoText: The text could not be recognised.
events.filesMissing: found a missing file when checking the files
events.filesChanged: found a changed file when checking the files
events.filesWhole: found everything in order again when checking the files

trash.title: Trash
trash.sub: Deleted documents stay here for 30 days, then they are gone with their files.
trash.purgeText: “{{title}}” is deleted with all its versions and files. This cannot be undone.

pdf.password: This PDF is protected by a password.

files.missingTitle: A file of this document is missing on the server.
files.missingText: This happens when the documents folder was restored or somebody deleted files. Bring the file back from your server's backup, then run "Check files". Then nexpaper sees that it is there again.
files.missingTextMember: This happens when files on the server were deleted or restored. Tell the operator of your server. They can bring the file back from the backup.
files.changedTitle: A file of this document is not the same any more.
files.changedText: Its checksum does not match the one nexpaper noted when it was filed. That can be a disk error, or somebody edited the file outside nexpaper. Restore the file from your server's backup, then run "Check files".
files.changedTextMember: Its checksum does not match the one nexpaper noted when it was filed. That can be a disk error, or somebody edited the file outside nexpaper. Tell the operator of your server. They can restore the file from the backup.
files.recheckFailed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

tagPicker.hasIt: The document has this tag already.
tagPicker.waiting: “{{name}}” is not a tag yet. Pick an entry of the list or create it as new.

senderPicker.title: Choose {{field}}
senderPicker.none: There are no senders yet. They appear once you give a document one.
senderPicker.isNew: No sender of this name. It will be created.

paperless.title: Take over from Paperless
paperless.text: Fetches everything through the interface of Paperless-ngx. The recognised text comes along, nothing is read again. Paperless itself stays untouched.
paperless.tokenHint: In Paperless under Profile, "API Auth Token". A token of the operator sees everything.
paperless.tokenKept: A token is kept. Leave empty to keep it.
paperless.private: Paperless runs in the own network
paperless.privateHint: Only with this ticked does nexpaper reach addresses in the home network or on this machine. A self-signed certificate is not trusted; in the own network use http.
paperless.how1: Correspondent → sender, document type → kind (unknown ones become new kinds), tags → tags
paperless.how2: Notes → notes, custom fields → one note with all values
paperless.how3: Storage paths and workflows → do not exist here, are left out

rules.title: Rules
rules.text: What nexpaper fills in by itself when a document arrives. Rules come before the AI. Most of them are made in the inbox with “Remember as a rule”.
rules.textVaults: What nexpaper fills in by itself when a document arrives in your vaults. Rules come before the AI. Most of them are made in the inbox with “Remember as a rule”.

rules.titleHint: In the title, {sender}, {kind}, {date}, {month}, {year} and {amount} stand for the fields of the document.

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.text: Kinds are kept under Organise: add, rename, merge and delete, with the number of documents.

ai.skipPersonalHint: Whatever lands in a personal vault never goes to a model. There, only rules apply.
ai.skipNote: Documents in personal vaults never get AI proposals.
ai.dailyLimitHint: At most this many documents go to the AI in one day (UTC), on the whole server. 0 means no limit. Once it is reached there are no more AI proposals until the next day; rules and the reading of the text go on.

events.movedByRule: moved it by a rule from {{from}} to {{to}}

trash.title: Move to the trash?
trash.text: "{{title}}" stays {{days}} days in the trash and can be brought back until then. After that it is gone with its files.

purge.title: Delete for good?
purge.text: "{{title}}" is deleted with all its versions and files. This cannot be undone.

note.title: Delete the note?
note.text: The note is deleted. This cannot be undone.

version.title: Discard version {{n}}?
version.text: Version {{n}} is deleted with its file. The document and the other versions stay. This cannot be undone.

sender.title: Delete the sender?
sender.text: "{{name}}" leaves the vault. Documents with this sender have no sender afterwards. This cannot be undone.

senderUsed.title: Delete the sender?
senderUsed.text: {{count}} documents have "{{name}}" as their sender. They have no sender afterwards. This cannot be undone.

rule.title: Delete the rule?
rule.text: New documents get nothing from this rule afterwards. Documents already filed stay as they are. This cannot be undone.

kind.title: Delete the kind?
kind.text: The kind "{{name}}" leaves the list. Documents with it stay, but have no kind afterwards. This cannot be undone.

kindUsed.title: Delete the kind?
kindUsed.text: {{count}} documents have the kind "{{name}}". They have no kind afterwards. This cannot be undone.

link.title: Withdraw the link?
link.text: Whoever has the link to "{{title}}" can no longer reach the document afterwards. A new link is always possible.

unshare.title: Remove the share?
unshare.text: {{name}} can no longer open "{{title}}" through this share afterwards.

members.title: Remove from the vault?
members.text_one: {{names}} sees nothing in this vault afterwards. Documents shared one by one stay visible. To let them back in, add them again.
members.text_other: {{names}} see nothing in this vault afterwards. Documents shared one by one stay visible. To let them back in, add them again.

export.title: Delete the export?
export.text: The ZIP file is deleted and the links to it stop working. This cannot be undone; a new export is possible.

exportLink.title: Withdraw the export link?
exportLink.text: Whoever has the link for {{name}} can no longer get the ZIP file afterwards. A new link is always possible.

device.title: Lock out the device?
device.text: "{{name}}" can no longer reach nexpaper afterwards. To use it again, pair it anew.

apiKey.title: Delete the key?
apiKey.text: Programs with the key "{{name}}" can no longer reach nexpaper afterwards. This cannot be undone.

session.title: End the session?
session.text: The browser of this session is signed out afterwards and has to sign in again.

pushDevice.title: Remove the device?
pushDevice.text: "{{name}}" gets no more notifications afterwards until it signs up again.

mailSender.title: Remove the address?
mailSender.text: Mails from {{address}} no longer land in your inbox afterwards. You can confirm it again later.

invite.title: Withdraw the invitation?
invite.text: The link of the invitation stops working. A new invitation is always possible.

locale.title: Remove the language?
locale.text: The uploaded language "{{name}}" is deleted. Whoever chose it sees the default language afterwards.

avatar.title: Remove the profile picture?
avatar.text: The picture is deleted. You can upload a new one at any time.

paperless.title: Forget the connection to Paperless?
paperless.text: The address and the access key are deleted. Documents already taken over stay. For another import you enter both again.

logoutOthers.title: Sign out everywhere else?
logoutOthers.text: All other browsers are signed out afterwards and have to sign in again. Paired devices stay.

mailAddress.title: Remove the mail address?
mailAddress.text: The address {{address}} is deleted. Without an address there is no link to reset the password and no notices by mail. You can enter a new one later.

oidcLink.title: Unlink the account?
oidcLink.text: Afterwards you no longer sign in with {{name}} but with your password. The link can be made again later.

tag.title: Delete tag?
tag.text: The tag “{{name}}” leaves the vault. This cannot be brought back.

tagUsed.title: Delete tag?
tagUsed.text: {{count}} documents carry the tag “{{name}}”. It is taken off them. This cannot be brought back.

kindServer.title: Delete kind?
kindServer.text: The kind “{{name}}” belongs to all vaults. It is taken off every document that has it, also in vaults you do not see. This cannot be brought back.

merge.title: Merge?
merge.senders_one: The document of “{{from}}” gets “{{into}}” as its sender. “{{from}}” is deleted. This cannot be brought back.
merge.senders_other: The {{count}} documents of “{{from}}” get “{{into}}” as their sender. “{{from}}” is deleted. This cannot be brought back.
merge.kinds_one: The document of kind “{{from}}” gets the kind “{{into}}”. “{{from}}” is deleted. This cannot be brought back.
merge.kinds_other: The {{count}} documents of kind “{{from}}” get the kind “{{into}}”. “{{from}}” is deleted. This cannot be brought back.
merge.tags_one: The document with the tag “{{from}}” gets “{{into}}”. “{{from}}” is deleted. This cannot be brought back.
merge.tags_other: The {{count}} documents with the tag “{{from}}” get “{{into}}”. “{{from}}” is deleted. This cannot be brought back.
merge.unused: “{{from}}” has no document and is deleted. This cannot be brought back.

filesCheck.title: Check files
filesCheck.text: Every file carries a checksum. Once a week nexpaper looks whether all documents are still there and unchanged, for example after a backup of the folder was put back.
filesCheck.started: The check runs in the background.
filesCheck.skipped_one: {{count}} document was being worked on and comes next time.
filesCheck.skipped_other: {{count}} documents were being worked on and come next time.
filesCheck.note: When a file is missing or no longer matches, the document shows a warning sign in the archive and you get a notice. The check reads in small portions with pauses, so the disk does not work all the time.

space.text: Where things lie and how much.

local.title: The database lies on a local drive.
local.text: On a network share (NFS, SMB) SQLite can lose data. nexpaper warns about it, here and in the log at the start. The documents themselves may lie on the NAS.

network.title: The database lies on a network share ({{type}}).
network.text: SQLite can lose data there or get stuck, because locking over the network is not reliable. Put the data folder (/data) on a local drive. Only /data/dokumente may lie on the NAS.

unknown.title: Cannot tell where the database lies.
unknown.text: On a Linux server with Docker nexpaper can see it. Check yourself that the data folder lies on a local drive and not on a network share.

space.documentsOnShare: The documents lie on a network share. That is fine.

keeping.newOnly: Keeping applies to newly filed ones
keeping.removed: {{name}}: no keeping time any more. Dates set by hand stay.
keeping.info: counts from the end of the year of the document's date: an invoice of 14.03.2026 kept for 10 years until 31.12.2036. Once the time is over, the document is listed under Deadlines, “May go”. nexpaper never deletes anything by itself.
keeping.examples: Examples from Germany, as of 2026, without guarantee: businesses keep accounting vouchers such as invoices for 8 years, books and annual accounts for 10, business letters for 6. Privately, invoices for work on a house are kept 2 years, otherwise there is mostly no duty. What applies to you, your tax adviser knows.

keeping.expired_other: For {{n}} the time would already be over. They are listed under Deadlines, “May go”; nothing is deleted by itself.
keeping.noneExpired: For none of them would the time be over yet.

keeping.trashHand: The date was set by hand on the document.
keeping.trashRunning: The time is not over yet.

keeping.mayGoEmpty: Nothing whose keeping time is over.

keeping.askText_other: They then stay in the trash for 30 days and can be brought back until then. After that they are gone for good, the files on the server too.

keeping.done_other: {{n}} in the trash. They can be brought back for 30 days.

keeping.failed_other: {{n}} could not be moved to the trash.
